subject: FY26 Preliminary School Budget Proposal
overview: The Medford School Committee held a public hearing and subsequently approved the proposed $87,583,000 preliminary school budget for fiscal year 2026 as its municipal request.

items.title: Presentation of Proposed FY26 Budget
items.summary: District administrators and finance staff presented a preliminary $87,583,000 budget for fiscal year 2026, detailing projected enrollment increases, salary adjustments, and critical maintenance and technology investments.

items.title: Public Hearing
items.summary: The public hearing on the proposed fiscal year 2026 budget was opened and closed with no members of the public speaking in favor or in opposition.

items.title: Committee Discussion and Budget Request Approval
items.summary: Committee members discussed historical spending alignment, middle school guidance levels, and federal grant uncertainties before voting to approve the budget as their formal municipal request.
